title: Estimating Guideline: General Contractor Overhead and Profit on HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Structure Claims
content:
**Estimating guideline: overhead and profit for the general contractor, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy other-structures supplementals.**

A storm job that brings several trades onto the property needs a general contractor to coordinate them. On the supplemental settlement of the other-structures part of a HomeGuard claim, overhead and profit for the general contractor is added at a percentage of the other-structures replacement-cost value. The percentage is set by the number of trades the storm job involves.

## Counting the trades

The trades are counted as the sum of two sets of entries:

- the claim's **first-settlement payment entries**: its actual-cash-value initial payments, full replacement-cost payments, actual-cash-value final payments and roof schedule payments, whatever the coverage part; and
- the **payment entries of the customer's FloodGuard Private Flood Policy claims with the same date of loss** as the HomeGuard claim.

Supplemental, recoverable-depreciation and reissue payments are not first-settlement payments and do not count. FloodGuard Private Flood Policy claim payments with a different date of loss do not count.

## Percentage

| Trades counted | Overhead and profit, percent of other-structures replacement-cost value |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10 |
| Exactly 2 | 5 |
| Fewer than 2 | Nothing |

The replacement-cost value is the one recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for other structures. The amount is added to the supplemental payment before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

- Dwelling actual-cash-value initial payment, other-structures actual-cash-value initial payment and a roof schedule payment on the HomeGuard claim: 3 trades, so 10 percent. On an other-structures replacement-cost value of 20000.00 that is 2000.00.
- Dwelling and other-structures actual-cash-value initial payments only: 2 trades, 5 percent, 1000.00 on the same value. Add one payment entry on the customer's FloodGuard Private Flood Policy claim for the same date of loss and the count becomes 3, so 10 percent.
- Only the other-structures actual-cash-value initial payment, plus a later recoverable-depreciation payment: 1 trade, so no overhead and profit.
